$comment: Forbidden patterns (MASTER_SPEC section 1 rule 12 + 6). The Slop Critic scores scenes against these ids; the renderer never applies them.

patterns.label: Excessive particle spam
patterns.rule: No particle fields unless a beat explicitly means diffusion/decay, max one system, density <= 0.4

patterns.label: Random camera shake
patterns.rule: Camera never shakes; motion only via defined entrance/emphasis/exit

patterns.label: Gratuitous zoom
patterns.rule: No full-scene zoom unless emphasis vocabulary 'subtleScale' with delta <= 0.08

patterns.label: Unnecessary glow
patterns.rule: Max 1 background glow per scene, intensity <= 0.4, must be subordinate to content

patterns.label: Rainbow / multi-hue palette
patterns.rule: One dominant accent per scene; max 2 accents ever

patterns.label: Visual clutter
patterns.rule: Max 5 elements per scene; negative space preserved

patterns.label: Repetitive layouts across scenes
patterns.rule: No identical composition+primitive+motion combo for same semantic purpose twice in a project

patterns.label: Bad typography
patterns.rule: Headline <= 4 lines, <= 60 chars, never shrunk below min size to fit

patterns.label: Meaningless decoration
patterns.rule: Every element must serve the beat's metaphor or hierarchy

patterns.label: Over-animation
patterns.rule: Max 2 simultaneous motion systems, max 6 element animations per scene

patterns.label: Weak / literal metaphor
patterns.rule: Visual must communicate the beat without narration

patterns.label: Generic AI aesthetic (stock gradients, glassmorphism, blob UI)
patterns.rule: Use design-system palette and geometry only

patterns.label: Meaningless 3D objects
patterns.rule: No 3D transforms beyond controlled parallax-free scale
